_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F03, talk N times (the owner, Q112): the 5th talk gives the orchard key (the gate on F05). finishOnClose: closing it finishes the event (its actions give the key).

text.zh_TW: 牧羊女：「你每次都回來看我……你是好人。」她從圍裙裡掏出一把生鏽的鑰匙。「這是塔裡舊果園的鑰匙。灰面具把一個人關在那裡……在上面兩層。」
text.en: Shepherd girl: "You keep coming back to see me... you're kind." She takes a rusty key from her apron. "It opens the old orchard in the tower. The grey masks locked someone in there... two floors up."

label.zh_TW: 「謝謝妳。我也會把妳的羊帶回來。」
label.en: "Thank you. I'll bring your sheep back too."
